summary: Sitowise Group Oyj, together with its subsidiaries, provides buildings, infrastructure, and digital solutions in Finland, Sweden, and internationally. The company offers building solutions, including structural, HVAC, and electrical and telecommunications engineering, as well as energy, automation, acoustics, fire safety, architecture, condition assessments and surveys, construction contracting and supervision, and professional kitchen and hospital equipment design. It also provides infrastructure solutions, such as road and railway design and land use, bridge design, geo-planning and geological surveys, transport planning and surveys, rock and tunnel planning, street and urban spaces and urban design, landscape architecture, sustainability services, streets and municipal infrastructure engineering and water services, and studies and surveys related to the environment, nature, noise, and chemicals. In addition, the company offers digital solutions comprising smart geospatial solutions; Smartlas, which offers collection of smart maps and reports; Planect, an urban impact assessment tool; Louhi, a GIS platform; Routa, an infrastructure management system; Foresta, a forest management system; and Infracontrol Online, a city control platform, as well as intelligent transport systems and automation. It serves the energy, data center, forest, and industry sectors, as well as cities and governments. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Espoo, Finland.
